inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes. What they are feeding us about Phoenix city leaders taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement is a total inversion of the real agenda. When the city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property, as FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports, they desperately want us to swallow the lie that it is routine governance. 

Do not fall for it. This is a synchronized operation by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. They are carefully managing the friction between agencies to condition the public and advance their concealed control grid. The official cover story is a fraud—every single move they make on city property is orchestrated from the top down.
